title: Compressed text reads use binary mode with a text encoding
reasoning: TextHandler passes mode 'r' and encoding='utf-8' without requesting text mode. Both gzip.open and bz2.open interpret 'r' as binary mode and reject the encoding argument. Consequently, registered compressed text formats cannot be read, including files produced by TextHandler.write.
reproduction: Load a valid .txt.gz or .txt.bz2 file through InputFile.from_path; opening the stream raises ValueError.
recommendation: Open text reads explicitly in 'rt' mode for all compression settings.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests do not exercise text handlers or compression.
suggestedRegressionTest: Verify text write/read round trips with NONE, GZIP, and BZIP2 compression using Unicode and empty content.
